scope: Implement the audited native-verification configuration, explicit focused continuation, test entry and evidence freshness changes. Offline synthetic verification only; no paid rerun, generated-game edits, formal frontend edits or Claude Code source changes.

changes.implementation: BGS dev launcher's native build environment sets the existing FEATURE_VERIFICATION_AGENT=0 build option. No core prompt, native Todo or Agent implementation edits. No agent/tool caps or permission bypass.
changes.verified: An isolated full CLI build and three fixed localhost model responses confirmed the mandatory system instruction and Todo completion nudge were absent from actual requests/results; initialization omitted verification but retained general-purpose, Agent, Bash and Skill.
changes.sideEffect: Removes the built-in verification role together with its mandatory policy. Agent may still voluntarily verify or delegate using general-purpose. Old history is not rewritten.
changes.deployment: Isolated build at /private/tmp/bgs-native-no-verifier-F0NfdI/cli-bun.js. Live dist and services were not replaced/restarted. Normal BGS launcher will apply the build setting on next deployment. Ad hoc native builds must also use the explicit feature configuration.

changes.implementation: Allow explicit continue + focused using the existing fresh-context mechanism and saved facts. Default remains resume; same workspace, requirement identity, prior user requests, Question answers, unresolved tool identities and historical evidence remain available. The independent debug selector now accepts settled interrupted/failed turns too.
changes.verified: Resume/focused continuations, pause, wrong continuation identity, missing/corrupt history, unknown exits, duplicate authorization, retained files and no implicit model dispatch covered by synthetic tests.
changes.limits: No automatic context reset. Assistant-only implicit decisions, loaded Skill bodies and old permission grants are not transferred. Long histories can still recur within a long turn.

changes.implementation: Optional preview.mjs --run <project-test.mjs> [args...] runs the selected script once with Node and current preview capability. Each execution retains separate stdout, stderr and execution.json; the CLI returns paths and process status, not a quality verdict. Raw output is not parsed as JSON. Existing tests are not rewritten or automatically migrated.
changes.verified: Actual native Bash sandbox, Node selection, literal arguments, nonzero exit, full 80KB output retention, read-only result retrieval, preservation of earlier runs, false checks with exit0 remaining quality-unverified, and rejection after capability revocation.
changes.auditCorrection: Direct Bun import from an individually allowlisted server file failed in the actual sandbox. Published the adapter and existing helper into the already-scoped private utility directory instead; no server-directory read grant was added.
changes.limits: Optional adapter; raw Agent Bash operations and old endpoint-bound scripts remain possible. Execution diagnostics are private, not automatically accepted public game evidence. No retry or assertion/quality inference.

changes.implementation: Read-only inspection distinguishes source/dependency identity, actual artifact bytes, report changes and each saved check's input identity. Source-only changes no longer imply that the old runtime artifact changed. Preview/export still refuse changed source packages; no blanket docs exclusion, automatic rerun, dependency framework or cross-version result cache.
changes.verified: Separate document/report/artifact mutation, old receipt retention, export refusal, unchanged runtime-smoke identity after docs-only change, checker/version and source fault regression, no new measurement or store write during inspection.
changes.limits: Matching identities describe the originally measured artifact and conditions, not a new source-to-build mapping, changed requirements, a new execution, test semantics or game quality.

typecheck.note: Cross-package source aliases and other repository-wide diagnostics. No diagnostics named this turn's changed files. No baseline-difference claim or unrelated core repair.

regression.syntaxAndWhitespace: Node syntax checks for the new adapter/debug client and git diff --check passed.
initialFailures: Sandboxed test harness could not open localhost ports; rerun with permission for local synthetic services only.
New test initially tried to inspect a revoked capability after settlement; corrected test to use the host read-only inspection API.
Source-copy build proof is stored separately from CheckResult.inputs; included that actual proof in build input-identity reporting.
Direct host adapter import failed in real sandbox; corrected publication without broadening permissions.

notClaimed: Live services are not yet using these changes; no service restart was performed.
No real-game quality, complete player-flow, Skills application or token reduction has been reaccepted.
No repair to firefly-nightwatch or magnet-dispatch game outputs was made.
No guarantee that a model will adopt optional tools, avoid small operations or stop voluntarily reviewing.
No claim that historical compaction was broken or that full repository typechecking passes.
